name: Big Money Incorporated

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-03-p4-80.html.

caption: The stable of Rich Money, Brandon James and Remo, led by manager Emma Chase, that targets Christian Faith, Steve Frehley, Lobster Warrior and Jack Bruce. The stable breaks up on SWF Legends in July 2008, when Emma Chase takes her client Brandon James to the Legends brand to face Christian Faith for the Supreme Championship and tells Rich Money and Remo they were never her clients.

name: Sexual Aggression

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/set-up-p1-2.html.

caption: The tag team of Joe Sexy and Angry Gilmore, who hold the SWF World Tag Team Championship through the diary's first two months.

name: The Amazing Bumfholes

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-03-p4-80.html.

caption: The tag team of brothers Randy and Zimmy Bumfhole, who lost the tag belts to Sexual Aggression in February 2008 and chase them. The brothers rename themselves The Immortal Bumfholes on Supreme TV in June 2008, saying that immortality, not gold, is what they are striving for. They beat The Heartbreakers on Supreme TV in Week 3 of August 2008 and in Week 1 of September accept Rich Money and Remo's challenge for Under Control 2008, asking that the winners get a one-on-one World Heavyweight Championship shot.

name: High Concept

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-03-p4-80.html.

caption: The Canadian tag team of Groucho Bling and Elmo Benson, whose "power of the headband" skits mentor Darryl Devine and Jacob Jett. They are one of the four teams Eric Tyler enters in the Sky Club Tag Team Championship tournament in July 2008. They beat The Upper Class in the Sky Club qualifier on SWF Legends in Week 2 of August 2008 and The Tokyo Underground at Welcome to the Jungle 2008 to become the first Sky Club tag champions, keep the belts against Double Deuce in Week 4, and lose a non-title match to Golden & Bloodstone in Week 1 of September.

name: Death Row

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/set-up-p1-2.html.

caption: The brawling tag team of Shady K and Knuckles.

identity.note: An exact name match with another promotion's own tag team or stable. Each is filed as its own per-promotion row, never merged.

name: Los Diablos

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-03-p4-80.html.

caption: The high-flying tag team of Antonio Marquez and Gino Montero. From Supreme TV in Week 3 of July 2008 they preach a revolución and the Mexi-Power salute against Richard Eisen, spray graffiti over the posters at the Dust Bowl, and call the movement La Revolución del Diablo. They beat Last Chance on Supreme TV in Week 3 of August 2008, Antonio Marquez making Flex Garcia submit, and lose to Remo & Ace in Week 1 of September; Richard Eisen promises Marquez a North American Championship shot if he wins his next match.

identity.note: An exact name match with another promotion's own tag team or stable. Each is filed as its own per-promotion row, never merged.

name: The Biggz Boyz

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-03-p4-80.html.

caption: The tag team of brothers Brett and Bart Biggz, four-time tag champions who lose their manager Jessie in April 2008. They beat The Tokyo Underground on SWF Legends in Week 1 of September 2008, Bart pinning Narato, after which Bart asks on the microphone for a Shooting Star Championship match with Acid.

name: Valiant & Giedroyc

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-03-p4-80.html.

caption: A rising tag team that chases Sexual Aggression's belts. They take the World Tag Team Championship from Sexual Aggression in June 2008 and defend it through Times of Trouble 2008 to the eve of The Supreme Challenge 28. They keep the belts at The Supreme Challenge 28 against The New Wave and Badd Kompany, and are booked against Sin Inc for Welcome to the Jungle 2008. They keep the belts against Sin Inc at Welcome to the Jungle 2008, when Giedroyc rolls up John McClean, against The Upper Class on Supreme TV in Week 3 of August and against The Heartbreakers in Week 1 of September; Richard Eisen names The New Wave the next challengers.

name: Consequences

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-03-p4-80.html.

caption: The tag team of Squeeky McClean and Steven Parker, named by Parker on Generation Supreme.

name: The Warriors

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-03-p4-80.html.

caption: The veteran tag team of Eric Tyler and Chris Caufield, brought in by Phil Vibert.

identity.note: An exact name match with another promotion's own tag team or stable. Each is filed as its own per-promotion row, never merged.

name: The Pain Alliance

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-04-p81-131.html.

caption: The tag team of Kurt Laramee and Big Smack Scott, reformed at The World is Watching.

name: Warrior Faith

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-03-p4-80.html.

caption: The tag team of Lobster Warrior and Christian Faith, formed against Big Money Incorporated. They beat Sin Inc on Supreme TV in Week 4 of July 2008, Chris Morrisette's surprise partner being the Supreme Champion. They beat Golden & Bloodstone on SWF Legends in Week 2 of August 2008, Chris Morrisette pinning Bloodstone after Christian Faith breaks up the Bloodstone Variation.

name: Badd Kompany

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/set-up-p1-2.html.

caption: The tag team of Joss Thompson and Sean Deeley, revealed at The World is Watching as the "B.K." of the video promos. They lose the three-way tag match for the number one contendership at Welcome to the Jungle 2008, are lectured by The Guru, who offers to manage them, and in Week 1 of September Sean Deeley and Joss Thompson each challenge Chris Morrisette.

name: The Samoan Wildboyz

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-03-p4-80.html.

caption: The tag team of Kid Toma and Akima Brave, managed by BJ O'Neill, who turn on The Biggz Boyz. On SWF Legends in Week 3 of August 2008 the team billed as The Samoan Wildboyz beats Strong Machine, Akima Brave pinning CL Machine.

name: Supreme Pain

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-03-p4-80.html.

caption: The tag team of Enforcer Roberts and Runaway Train.

name: The Supreme Dream

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-03-p4-80.html.

caption: The tag team of Eric Eisen and Enforcer Roberts.

name: Supreme Nightmare

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/ppv-the-world-is-watching-p104-111.html.

caption: The tag team of Eric Eisen and Runaway Train. They beat Jett Stream and Black Label Fight Club on SWF Legends in Week 2 of August 2008 and lose the number one contendership three-way to The New Wave at Welcome to the Jungle 2008.

name: Mass Effect

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-05-p145-200.html.

caption: The tag team of Steve Frehley and Ray Diaz, who face Big & Rich at Master of Puppets 2008. They beat The Upper Class on SWF Legends in Week 3 of August 2008 and The Watchmen in Week 1 of September, when Ray Diaz and Bryan Holmes fight over their history in Japan.

name: Big & Rich

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-05-p145-200.html.

caption: The tag team of Rich Money and Brandon James, who beat Mass Effect at Master of Puppets 2008.

name: The Almighty Dollar

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-05-p145-200.html.

caption: The tag team of Remo and Rich Money, who beat Valiant & Giedroyc by count-out on Supreme TV. The Fry Report calls them the Alpha Dogs. They beat Valiant, Giedroyc and Robbie Retro in a six-man tag with Ace Newton on Supreme TV in Week 4 of August 2008, and Rich Money suggests a match against The Immortal Bumfholes for Under Control 2008, which the Bumfholes accept on condition of a World Heavyweight Championship shot.

name: Sin Inc

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-06-p201-247.html.

caption: The tag team Joe Sexy forms with John McClean after he walks out on Angry Gilmore. They challenge any team for the number one contendership on Supreme TV in Week 4 of July 2008, are answered by Chris Morrisette and Christian Faith as Warrior Faith, and are booked against Valiant & Giedroyc for Welcome to the Jungle 2008. They lose the World Tag Team Championship match at Welcome to the Jungle 2008, ask Richard Eisen for a rematch at Under Control 2008 on the grounds that Valiant & Giedroyc cheated and are refused, beat Black Label Fight Club in Week 1 of September, and challenge The New Wave, the winner to be the next challengers.

name: Last Chance

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-06-p201-247.html.

caption: The tag team of Enforcer Roberts and Flex Garcia, formed after Roberts is fired from the Supreme Protectorate. They lose to Los Diablos on Supreme TV in Week 3 of August 2008 and beat Black Label Fight Club in Week 4.

name: Double Deuce

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-06-p201-247.html.

caption: The tag team of second-generation wrestlers Cameron Vessey and Casey Valentine, who run with Ace Newton. They challenge High Concept for the Sky Club tag belts on SWF Legends in Week 4 of August 2008 and lose; Cameron Vessey loses to Zimmy Bumfhole on Supreme TV in Week 1 of September, and the SWF.com recap has Double Deuce beat Technical Excellence on Generation Supreme.

name: The Upper Class

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-06-p201-247.html.

caption: The tag team of John Greed and Paul Huntingdon, beaten by The Amazing Bumfholes on Supreme TV. They win the Sky Club tag tournament qualifier on SWF Legends in July 2008 and are one of the four teams Eric Tyler enters in the tournament. They lose the Sky Club qualifier to High Concept in Week 2 of August 2008, a World Tag Team Championship match to Valiant & Giedroyc on Supreme TV in Week 3 and a match to Mass Effect on SWF Legends in the same week, and fall to Badd Kompany on Generation Supreme.

name: Black Label Fight Club

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-05-p145-200.html.

caption: The tag team formerly known as the Dirty White Boyz, back in the SWF as Blood Elderberry and Blood Bonham.

name: Tornado & Texas

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-05-p145-200.html.

caption: The tag team of Troy Tornado and Texas Pete, the newcomers who run with Rocky Golden.

name: Four Kings

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-05-p145-200.html.

caption: The stable of Ace Newton, Ash Campbell, Cameron Vessey and Casey Valentine, set up over three months on Generation Supreme, who challenge Robbie Retro's side to a Supreme Warfare match. Ace Newton, mentored by Rich Money, tells Supreme TV in Week 1 of September 2008 that the Four Kings are not done and are 'four friends' who stick together.

name: The Golden Faction

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-06-p201-247.html.

caption: The group Rocky Golden leads with Troy Tornado, Texas Pete and manager Kristen Pearce, who target Steve Frehley and Chris Morrisette. Johnny Bloodstone joins as the fourth man at Times of Trouble 2008, and Eric Eisen's offer to fold them into the Supreme Protectorate is refused on SWF Legends in June 2008. Troy Tornado, ordered to take the Supreme Championship from Christian Faith and hand it over, fails on SWF Legends in July 2008 and is attacked by the group; in Week 1 of August Rocky Golden says he is no longer a member. The group beat down Troy Tornado on SWF Legends in Week 2 of August 2008 and Rocky Golden beats the injured Ray Diaz at Welcome to the Jungle 2008; the three beat Robbie Retro and the Biggz brothers in Week 3, Texas Pete loses to Ray Diaz in Week 4, and in Week 1 of September Rocky Golden demands 'respect' from Eric Tyler.

name: Supreme Protectorate

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-05-p145-200.html.

caption: Eric Eisen's alliance, which he says his father entrusted to him to protect the SWF's interests; Runaway Train fires The Guru to prove his loyalty and Eisen fires Enforcer Roberts for failing.

name: Team N-R-G

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-04-p132-144.html.

caption: The team of Darryl Devine and Jacob Jett, who wear headbands and lose to the Samoan Wildboyz on Generation Supreme.

name: The New Wave

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/ppv-times-of-trouble-p248-256.html.

caption: The tag team of Thom Barrowman (Guide) and Jeremy Finch (Scout), who come over from TCW, are called by some the best tag team in the world, and work for the Legends brand and, by Richard Eisen's special request, on Supreme TV. They tell Chris Caufield on SWF Legends in July 2008 that they are leaving for the Supreme brand to chase the World Tag Team titles, and show up on Supreme TV in August managed by Jessie Gilmore, as part of Team Gilmore. They win the three-way tag match for the number one contendership at Welcome to the Jungle 2008; Guide loses to Rich Money for the World Heavyweight Championship on Supreme TV in Week 3 of August and Scout to Remo, and in Week 1 of September Scout loses a North American Championship match to Marc DuBois and the team accepts Sin Inc's challenge.

name: Remember Tomorrow

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-06-p257-307.html.

caption: The "army" Marc DuBois builds around his North American Championship on Supreme TV in June 2008, named by Steven Parker and completed by Jay Chord.

name: The Heartbreakers

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-07-p308-365.html.

caption: The tag team of Steven Parker and Jay Chord, who debut on Supreme TV in July 2008 against Valiant & Giedroyc for the World Tag Team Championship and lose. They lose to The Immortal Bumfholes on Supreme TV in Week 3 of August 2008 and challenge Valiant & Giedroyc for the World Tag Team Championship in Week 1 of September.

name: Team Retro

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-06-p257-307.html.

caption: The stable of Robbie Retro, Swoop McCarthy and the Biggz brothers, billed as Team Retro against the Four Kings in the Supreme Warfare match at Times of Trouble 2008.

name: Pure Energy

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-07-p308-365.html.

caption: The Canadian cruiserweight team of Lee Rivera and Shane Nelson, who debut on SWF Legends in July 2008 against the Samoan Wildboyz. They are one of the four teams Eric Tyler enters in the Sky Club Tag Team Championship tournament in July 2008. They lose the Sky Club qualifier to The Tokyo Underground on SWF Legends in Week 2 of August 2008, still without a win in the SWF, and the SWF.com recap has Death Row beat them on Generation Supreme.

name: The Samoan Family

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-06-p257-307.html.

caption: The stable of Kid Toma, Akima Brave and Tana, managed by BJ O'Neill, who call themselves the Samoan Family, take the Shooting Star Championship from Darryl Devine in June 2008 and say they will take the tag belts next. Rhino Umaga, Akima Brave's brother, is named the newest member in July 2008, and BJ O'Neill fields Akima and Rhino as The Samoan Wildboyz Version 2.0 in the Sky Club tag tournament qualifier.

name: The Tokyo Underground

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-07-p376-441.html.

caption: The masked high-flier Ota and Narato, brought to SWF Legends by Mr. Miwa in July 2008, who debut in a Sky Club ladder match against High Concept and are entered in the Sky Club tag tournament. They beat Pure Energy in the Sky Club qualifier on SWF Legends in Week 2 of August 2008, lose the final to High Concept at Welcome to the Jungle 2008, are named by Mr. Miwa as the first of his House of the Rising Sun, and lose to The Biggz Brothers in Week 1 of September.

name: Jett Stream

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-07-p376-441.html.

caption: The tag team of Jacob Jett and Mainstream Hernandez, formed in July 2008 after Jett, Elmo Benson and Groucho Bling came to Hernandez's rescue on Generation Supreme, who lose to the Samoan Wildboyz and to Death Row on SWF Legends. They lose a three-way to The Supreme Nightmare on SWF Legends in Week 2 of August 2008, take Katie Cameron as manager in Week 3, and lose to The Watchmen in Week 4, Mainstream Hernandez trying out the slogan nickname Kid Liquid.

name: Retro & Swoop

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-08-p442-485.html.

caption: Robbie Retro and Swoop McCarthy, billed as a tag team on Supreme TV in August 2008, who beat Double Deuce and lose to Sin Inc.

name: Strong & Hernandez

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-07-p376-441.html.

caption: A makeshift pairing of the newcomers Erik Strong and Mainstream Hernandez for the Sky Club tag tournament qualifier on SWF Legends in July 2008, which they lose.

name: The Samoan Wildboyz Version 2.0

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-07-p376-441.html.

caption: BJ O'Neill's second Samoan team, Akima Brave and his brother Rhino Umaga, entered in the Sky Club tag tournament qualifier on SWF Legends in July 2008.

name: Team Gilmore

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-07-p376-441.html.

caption: The group Jessie Gilmore names on Supreme TV in August 2008: Angry Gilmore, his wife and manager Jessie, and The New Wave, who say they are taking over the promotion and try to recruit others. After Angry Gilmore loses to Remo at Welcome to the Jungle 2008, the group use the opening of Supreme TV in Weeks 3 and 4 of August and Week 1 of September to demand title shots, Gilmore complaining that he has not been booked for three weeks.

name: Bang

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-08-p442-485.html.

caption: Pistol Pete Hall and Steve Flash, billed as Bang on Generation Supreme in Week 1 of August 2008 in a tag match against Black Label Fight Club and Swoop & Jameson. They beat Strong Machine and a masked team called The Ultimates on Generation Supreme in Week 3 of August 2008.

name: The Watchmen

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-08-p486-569.html.

caption: Bryan Holmes and JD Morgan, the veterans Eric Tyler brings in to the Legends brand in Week 3 of August 2008 as his watchmen against Phil Vibert; they win their first match, over Jett Stream, in Week 4, and lose to Mass Effect in Week 1 of September.

name: Strong Machine

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-08-p486-569.html.

caption: Erik Strong and the newcomer CL Machine, who debut as a team on SWF Legends in Week 3 of August 2008 against The Samoan Wildboyz and lose, and lose again to Bang on Generation Supreme.

name: House of the Rising Sun

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-08-p486-569.html.

caption: The stable that Mr. Miwa says he is master of rather than manager, announced on SWF Legends in Week 4 of August 2008 with Ota and Narato as its first members and the promise of more wrestlers from Japan to come.

name: The XDW Crew

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/swf-generation-supreme/archive/month-2008-09-p570-601.html.

caption: The five wrestlers of the backyard Xtreme Danger Wrestling who come to the narrator's office in Week 1 of September 2008 asking for work, in a race they call The Quest to be the first to land a job with a big American promotion.
